title: Morphology-aware deep learning predicts colorectal cancer survival from whole-slide images
abstract: arXiv:2610.17603v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Five-year survival prediction from hematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images could support risk stratification, but the task is weakly supervised, and the tissue morphologies carrying prognostic information remain incompletely characterized.   Methods: We conducted a retrospective secondary analysis using TCGA-COAD/READ (n=562) for morphology-specific analysis, Alliance/ CALGB 89803 (n=424) for model development, and SurGen (n=218) for external evaluation. We propose MorphContrast, a morphology-aware contrastive multiple-instance learning framework that uses tissue labels as structural supervision for five-year survival prediction. translated_title: 形态学感知的深度学习从全切片图像预测结直肠癌生存期
translated_abstract: 背景：基于苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色全切片图像的五年生存预测可支持风险分层，但该任务属于弱监督学习，且携带预后信息的组织形态学尚未得到完全表征。方法：我们开展了一项回顾性二次分析，使用TCGA-COAD/READ（n=562）进行形态学特异性分析，使用Alliance/CALGB 89803（n=424）进行模型开发，并使用SurGen（n=218）进行外部评估。我们提出了MorphContrast，一种形态学感知的对比多实例学习框架，它将组织标签作为结构监督用于五年生存预测。MorphContrast将门控注意力池化与三个辅助目标相结合：patch级别的形态学标签定义患者内部的对比，结局的一致性或不一致性定义形态学匹配的患者间对比，而多样性正则化则抑制表征坍塌。
tldr: 该研究提出MorphContrast——一种形态学感知的对比多实例学习框架，利用组织标签作为结构监督，从H&E全切片图像有效预测结直肠癌患者的五年生存期。
en_tdlr: MorphContrast, a morphology-aware contrastive multiple-instance learning framework that leverages tissue labels as structural supervision to predict five-year colorectal cancer survival from H&E whole-slide images.
